# Floating panes (Rex's New Floating Pane): a shell of its own over the
# split, with the keyboard; minimized, out of sight with its program
# running (the split's pane has the keyboard again); toggled back; saved
# with the layout; closed with ⌘W while it has the keyboard, not the split's
# pane. Run with --persist (the layout is saved by session).
expect-floating:0
action:new_floating_pane
wait:1.2
expect-floating:1 keyboard
type:echo FLOAT-$((40+2))
key:enter
wait:0.6
expect:FLOAT-42
action:toggle_floating_panes
wait:0.4
expect-floating:0
type:echo SPLIT-$((40+3))
key:enter
wait:0.6
expect:SPLIT-43
expect-panes:1
action:toggle_floating_panes
wait:0.4
expect-floating:1 keyboard
roundtrip:go
# ⌘W in it closes it, and only it.
key:cmd+w
wait:1.0
expect-floating:0
expect-panes:1
expect:SPLIT-43
